description: Create a Gemini TTS task on RunAPI (text to speech). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for async notifications. Declared type: string.

dialogue_turns.description: Non-empty ordered dialogue turns whose speaker ids reference configured speakers. Declared type: array.

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

sample_context.description: Overall delivery context and tone. Declared type: string.

scene.description: Scene and recording environment. Declared type: string.

speakers.description: Non-empty speaker configurations with unique Speaker N identifiers. Declared type: array.

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: text_to_speech
